runs.t: Clark Pacific is expanding to the Pacific Northwest — new plant opening Q3 2026.
We're looking for ambitious builders — engineers, craftspeople, and leaders who want to work on the structures that define California.

At Clark Pacific, you're not just manufacturing components — you're part of a team that transforms how California builds. Our plants are state-of-the-art, our project teams are collaborative, and our commitment to safety is absolute.
From design engineers to concrete finishers, every role plays a direct part in delivering the buildings that shape our region.
With facilities in West Sacramento, Woodland, Perris, and French Camp, Clark Pacific offers career opportunities throughout California — with the Pacific Northwest coming soon.
West Sacramento, CA — Headquarters & Main Plant
French Camp, CA — Central Valley Plant
Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families, including mental health support.

runs.t: At Clark Pacific, engineers don’t just design — they build.
Join a team where innovation, prefabrication, and hands-on collaboration come together to create smarter, safer, high-performance structures.
I started on the plant floor and now lead projects. At Clark Pacific, you
see what you build go up
— and there’s always a next step.
Project Engineer · 9 years at Clark Pacific
Browse all open positions or reach out directly — we're always looking for talented people who want to make an impact.
Clark Pacific is a leading manufacturer of prefabricated building systems. We are transforming design and construction by delivering high-quality, cost-effective buildings with less risk.
